name: convohub-sync-core
description: Shared backbone for the Superside sales plugins: resolves which team's Notion databases a BDR belongs to (via the Sales page), bootstraps a new team's Notion setup on first run (creating the four databases from an exact spec and asking team name + AEs), imports a rep's Salesforce priority accounts, and provides /weekly-sync to run the email, cold-call, and LinkedIn syncs together weekly. Works for whichever rep and team invokes it.
